options.text: Grant the least privilege needed for a task
options.rationale: Correct: least privilege limits blast radius.

options.text: Use SSH keys instead of password logins where possible
options.rationale: Correct: keys are stronger than passwords.

options.text: Run all daily work as the root user

items.stem: Why quote variables like "$file" in a shell script?

options.text: To prevent word splitting and globbing on spaces or special characters
options.rationale: Correct: quoting protects values with spaces or wildcards.

options.text: To make the script run faster
options.rationale: Quoting is about correctness, not speed.

options.text: To convert the variable to a number
Because unquoted variables are a syntax error
options.rationale: They are not a syntax error, just unsafe.
